column1: # Phase 5d reviewed static web assets for the functional /webui-modern WAR.
# The Phase 5d slice serves exactly one flow:
#     login -> role selection -> desktop/menu -> read-only "Error Message" window
# Every row below was reviewed against that flow. The build reads this ledger, so
# a directory cannot join the archive without a recorded decision, and
# `verifyPhase5dModernWebWar` independently rejects the excluded classes of
# content listed at the bottom of this file.
# The Phase 5d entry pages, the Servlet 6 descriptor, the ZK 10 configuration and
# the replacement stylesheet are NOT listed here: they live in
# zkwebui/src/phase5d/webapp and are contributed by the war task's
# webAppDirectory, because they are authored for this phase rather than reused.
